title: Music playlist player with the audio element
when: The user wants a music player with a playlist, play and pause, next and previous, seek, volume, shuffle and repeat.
prompt:
Goal: A keyboard friendly player with correct shuffle and repeat behavior built on one audio element.
Steps:
1. One audio element driven by JavaScript; tracks from playlist.json { title, artist, src } parsed in try and catch, or user picked files as object URLs.
2. Buttons with aria-label: play and pause (aria-pressed), previous, next, shuffle, repeat (off, all, one); labeled range inputs for seek and volume; time "1:23 / 3:45".
3. logic.mjs: nextIndex(i, length, { shuffle, repeat, order }), shuffleOrder(n, rand), formatTime(seconds).
4. timeupdate moves the seek bar unless the user drags it; ended advances by repeat mode; error skips with a message in role="status".
5. Playlist as an ol of buttons; the current one has aria-current="true".
6. Media Session metadata and handlers when available; volume and last track in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: next and previous in every mode, formatTime.
Quality bar:
- Previous restarts the track after 3 seconds in.
- Shuffle plays each track once per cycle.
- Controls stay usable at 320 px.
Pitfalls:
- Calling play() without handling its rejected promise.
- Seek bar jumping while dragging.
- Autoplay on load.
Verify:
- [ ] Buttons named.
- [ ] Ranges labeled.
- [ ] Status for errors.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (queue rules), playlist.json, test.mjs.

examples.output: cover, title, play/pause, prev/next, seek, shuffle, repeat one/all
